In a class, 18 students have a red notebook, 15 students have a blue bag, and 7 students have both. How many students are there (at least) in the class? The minimum number of students is calculated by adding the students with red notebooks and blue bags, then subtracting those who have both to avoid double-counting. This gives 18 + 15 - 7 = 26. Therefore, the least number of students in the class is 26.

That's all I have to say.
